article.title: Boy band BTS' J-Hope teases the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 ahead of launch
article.summary: Samsung is hosting a Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22 in London, where it's expected to unveil its new folding smartphones, including the Galaxy Z Fold8, the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, and the Galaxy Z Flip8. We already know what these foldables will look like due to previous leaks, but we are now getting our best look yet at a working Fold8 as it's teased by BTS member J-Hope. South Korean boy band BTS' Jung Ho-seok, known professionally as J-Hope, posted a short Instagram Story on his account teasing the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8. There's nothing new to glean from this Story, but it corroborates...

article.title: Moonshot Plans IPO in Six Months After China AI Breakthrough
article.summary: Moonshot AI has told investors it’s preparing to list in as early as six months, seizing the opportunity to tap capital markets after its latest model upended industry perceptions of China’s artificial intelligence capabilities and sent tech stocks reeling.

article.title: 1Password’s new browser integration for Claude changes how AI uses your credentials
article.summary: As AI agents tackle more tasks, such as managing online accounts , authentication has become a practical engineering problem. For example, companies like Coinbase are already running over a thousand agents in production . Enter a new 1Password feature for Claude that is designed to let a fleet of agents sign in without ever exposing passwords to the LLM.  The company calls this new browser integration a “zero-exposure security framework.” Credentials are decrypted only when needed and passed directly to the browser, allowing Claude to complete an action without ever seeing the underlying password or one-time authentication code. Decryption stays on-device  Nancy Wang , CTO of 1Password, tells The News Stack that credential decryption and filling happen locally on the
article.title_zh: 1Password 推出 Claude 新型瀏覽器集成功能——改變 AI 使用認證方式
article.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 代理承擔越來越多任務（如管理在線帳戶），身份驗證已成為實際的工程問題，新推出的 1Password for Claude 功能旨在讓 AI 代理隊伍能夠安全地進行大規模生產操作。

article.summary: Chinese startup Moonshot AI released a new artificial-intelligence model on July 17 that drew global attention both for its powerful capabilities and for sending stock markets reeling around the world.

article.title: Google explains the design of Android’s new Noto 3D emoji
article.summary: To mark World Emoji Day, Google has delved into the design of its new 3D emoji. As previewed at The Android Show in May, all 3,977 emoji characters have been redesigned to be three-dimensional.

article.title: 5 Motorola software features I wish were on every Android phone
article.summary: We give Motorola a lot of criticism for its software . It’s justified — Motorola’s update practices are nothing short of terrible, and they deserve to be called out. Ignore updates, though, and Motorola’s Hello UI is one of my favorite Android skins. From gestures that debuted over a decade ago to new software tricks for folding phones, there are plenty of Motorola software features I wish all my phones had.
article.title_zh: 5 項 Motorola 軟體功能我希望出現在每部 Android 手機上
article.summary_zh: 儘管 Motorola 更新政策不佳，但其 Hello UI 是最受歡迎的 Android 皮膚之一，擁有許多值得推薦的功能。

article.title: The bottleneck for AI agents isn’t the model anymore. It’s the context layer.
article.summary: There’s a pattern I’ve watched repeat for two years. A team builds an agent, hits reliability problems, upgrades the model, sees marginal improvement, and hits the same reliability problems in a slightly different form. The diagnosis is always the same: the model wasn’t smart enough. The fix is always to try a new, smarter model. The result is always the same: still broken.  This isn’t a model problem. It never was. Andrej Karpathy figured this out months ago, and in a post on X , he noted a shift in how he was spending his AI compute: “a large fraction of my recent token throughput is going less into manipulating code, and more into manipulating knowledge.” He wasn’t running a smarter model. He was building better infrastructure:  raw so
article.title_zh: AI agents 的瓶頸不再是模型——而是 context layer
article.summary_zh: 在過去兩年裡,我發現了一個重複出現的模式:團隊構建 agent、遇到可靠性問題、升級模型、看到邊際改進,然後以略微不同的形式遇到相同的可靠性問題。診斷結果總是一樣的:模型不夠聰明。

article.title: Your personal data is for sale: here is how to take it off the internet
article.summary: If you could go back to the early days of the internet, would you handle your privacy differently? Most of us would. We would be more cautious about the services we joined and the information we shared. Since a time machine is not an option, we have to deal with the reality of the present. Your personal data is currently available and for sale at this very moment. Right now, your phone number, email address, home address, and even your family connections are being packaged and sold to marketers, insurers, and hackers. While Apple’s privacy protections in Safari and Mail help block some tracking as you browse the web, they cannot undo years of information already scraped and spread across hundreds of broker databases. Data brokers have built a multi-billion-dollar industry by collecting you
article.title_zh: 你的個人資料在販售中：以下是如何將其從網際網路上移除的方法
article.summary_zh: 如果你能回到網際網路早期，是否會以不同方式處理隱私？大多數人會更謹慎地選擇加入的服務和分享的資訊。
